chunks: He was asked about a woman who undergoes khulʿ: does she have housing and maintenance? So he said: “She has no housing and no maintenance.”
And he was asked about a woman who undergoes khulʿ: does she have mutʿah? He said: “No.”

key_terms.الْمُخْتَلِعَةِ: a woman who undergoes khulʿ, a divorce initiated through compensation
key_terms.سُئِلَ: he was asked regarding a legal matter
key_terms.سُكْنَى: housing or residence entitlement after divorce
key_terms.نَفَقَةٌ: financial maintenance owed to a wife or divorcee

ai.seo_question: Is a woman divorced through khulʿ entitled to housing, maintenance, or mutʿah?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a woman who undergoes khulʿ. It states that she is not entitled to housing, maintenance, or mutʿah in this case, making it a concise fiqh ruling in the chapter of divorce by mutual consent.
